intro: Widespread coverage focuses on gaps in understanding actual AI usage patterns across organizations and populations. The White House faces scrutiny over potential conflicts of interest as Trump administration officials and allies gain financial stakes in AI companies with minimal oversight. Meanwhile, China contests US calls for slower AI development, viewing them as strategic positioning, while safety concerns and regulatory debates continue to divide industry leaders and policymakers.
